sample_rule: first two source training witnesses plus 15 hash-selected prospective training and 15 prospective validation cases, excluding the witnesses
future_split: hash-based 80/20 of previous 434 usable cases; only for future fresh training; previous checkpoints saw both roles
target_boundary: NQ train reference answers are diagnosis-only; 100 eval question hashes are exclusion-only; no eval passage/answer/Silver fields are loaded
cache_policy: local-files-only models, datasets and existing compressed index; fail on missing cache; no index building
review_policy: all 32x50 raw texts, separate blinded support-review view, labels initially null; support judgments must cite original text
boundary_pair_rule: strongest and weakest weak-negative Top-5 members versus nearest two and deepest missed weak-positive; same Reader rank-band nearest-score nonpositive control; dependent descriptive pairs
gate: exact cohort/candidate/weak-mask identity, prior two witness parity, complete trace replay; support-quality conclusion awaits independent review
kill_condition: stop export on identity/cache/trace/upload failure; no next training objective is automatically approved
